author: chevalierdeces
quote: sold what the previous game is known for especially in humour for attempted mass appeal that debases the game. certain features seem intended for certain markets and are embarrassing, ie parts of it seeming to be the fantasies of middle aged black women. the story is awful. the only thing i enjoyed was driving around certain areas of the map, the map following essentially the same formula as GTA 5 with improvements. ultimately just another grand theft auto game, albeit one that could not live up to 13 years of hype and development, and albeit one that has devolved from past titles, excluding the vapid selling points like 'you can go fish'. the title simply could not escape from many actualities and chose the wrong direction for other features.
